title: Lustron House, 103 Lake Front Drive, Beverly Shores, Porter County, IN
notes: When this survey was carried out, the park was called Indiana Dunes National Lakeshore. The park's name was changed to Indiana Dunes National Park in 2019. The survey's address has been updated to include the new park name.

Significance: Lustron homes, first created to alleviate the post-World War II housing crises, were considered a viable test of prefabricated residential construction.  The homes illustrate innovative material applications and new manufacturing techniques.  An interest in prefabricated steel and porcelain enamel houses links the Lustron houses at Beverly Shores to their neighbor and predecessor, the 1933-34 Century of Progress Exposition Armco-Ferro House, a frameless structure built of load-bearing steel and enamel panels.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 86001472
